text: 有哪些追求女生的惯用套路
en: What are the common routines for pursuing girls

text: 我也想要人疼，我也想要人宠
en: I too want someone to dote on me, I too want someone to pamper me

text: 我也想要浪漫，我也想要惊喜
en: I too want romance, I too want surprises

text: 我也想在失落的时候有人抱抱
en: I too want someone to hug me when I'm feeling down

text: 我也不喜欢生病的时候只有杯热水
en: I also don't like it when I'm ill and there's only a cup of hot water

text: 我也想有人赚钱给我花
en: I too want someone to earn money for me to spend

text: 我也想要好看的衣服和lv公文包
en: I too want nice clothes and an LV briefcase

text: 我也喜欢对着镜子臭美
en: I too like to preen in front of the mirror

text: 我也喜欢老婆好看，学历还高
en: I too like it when the wife is good-looking and highly educated

text: 我也喜欢你死心塌地对我，陪我作和闹
en: I too like it when you are devoted to me and indulge my tantrums and fuss

text: 我也想要骑着白马的公主带我去她城堡
en: I too want a princess on a white horse to take me to her castle

text: 我也想当个仙女，你摘的星星我都要
en: I too want to be a fairy, and I want every star you pick

text: 可你们只会一巴掌把我扇到90度的角
en: But all you do is slap me into a 90-degree angle

text: 说一句给老娘工作去，闹什么闹
en: saying, 'Get to work, this old lady here has things to do, stop making a scene'

text: 关注我吧，我们一起手拉手，作仙女去！
en: Follow me, and let's hold hands and go be fairies together!

text: 我去，这都有人上纲上线？
en: Bloody hell, someone's actually making a big deal out of this?

text: 私以为，每个人都有自己的脆弱面，正视自己的脆弱面并不是什么丢人的事情，反而敢于正视自己的人才是一种勇气吧？
en: Personally, I think everyone has their own vulnerable side; facing up to one's vulnerability is nothing to be ashamed of, and rather, daring to face oneself takes a kind of courage, doesn't it?

text: 我的感觉是，这个男人如果在一个人面前表现的成熟稳重，谈吐有度，学识渊博，多金潇洒，那这个男人大多是和你不熟，或者是想泡你。
en: My feeling is that if a man behaves mature and steady in front of someone, speaks with measured words, is erudite, wealthy and dashing, then most likely he either doesn't know you well, or wants to hit on you.

text: 如果一个男人在你面前随性自由，错漏百出，逗逼二逼，甚至邋里邋遢，孩子气十足，碰上喜欢的走不动道，智商经常不满五岁。
en: If a man is free and easy in front of you, full of mistakes, acts like a goof, even looks slovenly and unkempt, is utterly childish, freezes up around the girl he likes, and his IQ is often under five.

text: 那恭喜你，你已经是这个男人的“自己人”了。
en: Then congratulations — you have already become this man's 'own person'.

text: 男人这种生物从未成长，只是越来越善于把自己孩子的一面伪装，只在最信任的面前表露无遗。
en: Men as a species never grow up; they only grow better at disguising their childish side, revealing it fully only in front of those they trust most.

text: 真实的一面，是想杀人放火，还是想肆无忌惮的任性。
en: The real side — is it the wish to kill and commit arson, or the urge to be recklessly willful?

text: 呵呵，我想想，那些发自内心真实的哭和笑都算是真实吧
en: Haha, let me think — those cries and laughs that come from the heart probably count as real, don't they?

text: 曾因为上学坐在喜欢女孩后面而兴奋，处处表现的不在意，但只要有她的地方处处小心谨慎
en: I was once excited to sit behind the girl I liked at school, acting indifferent everywhere, yet being cautious and careful wherever she was

text: 曾因为中午操场打篮球看见了她而激动，像吃了士力架一样的疯狂得分，进球后酷酷转身
en: I was once thrilled to see her while playing basketball on the playground at noon, scoring like mad as if I'd eaten a Snickers, then turning coolly away after a basket

text: 曾因为她的心情、空间里状态的改变，会让自己像一个画家一样的天马行空瞎琢磨
en: I once, because of changes in her mood and her status updates in her space, would let my imagination run wild like a painter, pondering aimlessly

text: 曾因为每堂下课后能在楼道多看她一眼而高兴，每次上课都期盼着下课
en: I was once happy just to catch one more glimpse of her in the hallway after each class, looking forward to the bell every lesson

text: 曾因为看到小痞子抽烟很帅气，拿起一根儿烟呛得我咳嗽不止
en: I once, thinking the little punk looked cool smoking, picked up a cigarette and choked myself into a fit of coughing

text: 曾因为看到老爹喝酒与老妈大吵，蛮不讲理，发誓自己长大绝不当个酒鬼
en: I once, seeing my old man drink and have a huge row with my mum, being utterly unreasonable, swore I would never become a drunkard when I grew up

text: 曾因为看到朋友跟老师溜须拍马，背地瞧不起他，认为他一辈子没出息
en: I once, seeing a friend suck up to the teacher, looked down on him behind his back, thinking he would never amount to anything

text: 曾因为听到最喜欢的女孩对你说那句我爱你，真的觉得爱情可以战胜一切
en: I once, on hearing the girl I liked most say those words 'I love you' to you, truly believed love could conquer everything

text: 第一次跟哥们逃课去网吧
en: The first time I skipped class with my mates to go to an internet café

text: 第一次跟校外流氓打架
en: The first time I got into a fight with an off-campus hooligan

text: 第一次跟喜欢的女孩儿表白
en: The first time I confessed to the girl I liked

text: 第一次牵手接吻
en: The first time I held hands and kissed

text: 第一次在外面租房
en: The first time I rented a room outside

text: 第一次被最铁的朋友抢走恋人
en: The first time my closest friend stole my lover

text: 第一次体会失去亲人
en: The first time I experienced the loss of a loved one

text: 第一次离开校园，步入社会
en: The first time I left campus and stepped into society

text: 第一次在领导面前溜须拍马
en: The first time I flattered a boss to his face

text: 第一次在客户面前推杯换盏
en: The first time I clinked glasses and toasted with a client

text: 第一次在豪车面前再次落败失恋
en: The first time I was beaten again and left heartbroken in front of a fancy car

text: 我终于变成了自己最讨厌的那种人，但真实是什么呢？
en: I finally became the kind of person I hated most, but what is real?

text: 我想要的快乐或许很简单，但责任重了，当男生变成男人时，何所谓真实不真实，最大的真实，就是想让周围的人因为我的存在能过的更好一些
en: The happiness I want may be simple, but the responsibilities grow heavier; when a boy becomes a man, what is there to say about real or not real? The greatest reality is the wish that those around me can live a little better because I exist

text: 外面还在刮着风，树叶也一面面落下
en: Outside the wind is still blowing, and the leaves fall one by one

text: 我猛吸了三口烟，咳嗽不止
en: I took three deep drags of my cigarette and coughed uncontrollably

text: 隐约看到一个少年在学校角落里生疏的点着烟，他的样子真滑稽，被呛到咳嗽不止
en: I vaguely saw a teenager awkwardly lighting a cigarette in a corner of the school; his manner was truly ridiculous, choking and coughing without stop

text: 男人，承担不起一个女人的人生。
en: Men cannot take on a woman's whole life.

text: 现代社会，男人的能力，并不一定比女人强。
en: In modern society, a man's capability is not necessarily greater than a woman's.

text: 在当今社会，男人，早已经无能为力，承担一个同龄女人，所需要的物质标准，精神需求。
en: In today's society, men have long been powerless to meet the material standards and emotional needs that a woman of the same age requires.

text: 女人不要去找同龄的男人要安全感。
en: Women should not go to men of the same age demanding a sense of security.

text: 以找依靠，找可以提供安全感的男人为目标。
en: Make it your aim to find someone to rely on, a man who can provide a sense of security.

text: 女人应该去找大叔，找大你十岁以上的男人。
en: Women should look for older men — men more than ten years their senior.

text: 同龄的男人，他们和你们一样上学，一样工作，他们懂的东西并不比你们多。
en: Men of the same age go to school and work just like you; they don't know more than you do.

text: 要求他们，负担起一个同龄人的未来，这要求太苛刻了。
en: To ask them to shoulder the future of a peer — that demand is too harsh.

text: 他们提供不了安全感，他们也缺乏安全感。
en: They cannot provide a sense of security, and they lack it themselves.

text: 彼此的无度索取，对双方来说，都是一种伤害。
en: This endless taking from each other is a kind of harm to both sides.

text: 如果你并不试图在男人那里要依靠，要安全感。
en: If you don't try to demand reliance and a sense of security from men.

text: 那么男女之间，会少很多矛盾。
en: Then there would be far fewer conflicts between men and women.

text: 现实的感情，也不会这样扭曲。
en: Realistic feelings wouldn't be so distorted either.

text: 一般来说，要求越简单的男生其实标准越高。
en: Generally speaking, boys who ask for less actually have higher standards.

text: 他们需要私人空间，可以跟朋友打游戏搞聚会。
en: They need their private space, to game and party with friends.

text: 有些时间真的不需要你的参与。
en: There are times they really don't need you involved.

text: 男生特别反感翻旧账，不好的事情最好不要再去提。
en: Boys especially resent dredging up old grievances; it is best not to bring up bad things again.

text: 生活中他需要你是女儿，可以撒娇可爱卖萌娇喘。
en: In daily life he needs you to be a daughter — coy, adorable, and playfully coquettish.

text: 下班了他需要你是妈妈，可以体贴温柔倾听安慰。
en: After work he needs you to be a mother — considerate, gentle, listening and comforting.

text: 世界上最愚蠢的问题就是“救你还是救他妈”，亲人和爱人没的选，要是只能有其一，你会失望的。
en: The stupidest question in the world is 'save you or save his mother'; you cannot choose between a loved one and a lover, and if you could only have one, you would be let down.

text: 恋爱和结婚是两码事。
en: Dating and marriage are two different matters.

text: 男生享受自在的恋爱，也会喜欢平稳的婚姻，这是他的成长过程。
en: Boys enjoy a free and easy romance, and also come to like a stable marriage; this is his process of growing up.

text: 不要试图去混淆和改变。
en: Don't try to blur the line or change it.

text: 男生喜欢衣着得体，落落大方的女生，对于那些浓妆艳抹奇装异服，真的只是看看而已。
en: Boys like girls who dress appropriately and carry themselves with poise; those who are heavily made-up and oddly dressed are really just for looking at.

text: 做作的女生不招人喜欢。
en: Affected girls are not likeable.

text: 你可以笨也可以傻，就是别装。
en: You can be dim or daft, just don't put on an act.

text: 你对你的身材可以不用太过在意，他们说喜欢超模身材很多只是说说而已，并不会要求他老婆也这么干。
en: You don't need to worry too much about your figure; when they say they like supermodel bodies it is often just talk, and they won't actually expect their wife to be that way.

text: 在外面帮他挣面子，在家里帮他弄里子。
en: Earn him face outside, and look after the practical side at home.

text: 他会越来越爱你的。
en: He will love you more and more.

text: 他们也喜欢独立的女人。
en: They also like independent women.

text: 所以，脑子好的话，不要让他们掏钱买iphoneX。
en: So, if you are smart, don't make them pay for an iPhone X.

text: 只说两个点，喜欢美女，喜欢做爱，直到他不行了。
en: Just two points: they like beautiful women, and they like having sex, until they can't anymore.

text: 而且这个事情，大部分男人不会主动对别人讲，包括自己的女盆友，甚至老婆，可能也有怕被说成变态的心理。
en: And on this matter, most men won't bring it up voluntarily with others, including their own girlfriend, even their wife — perhaps also out of a fear of being called perverted.

text: 对普通关系者说的不要深入是对的，看语境吧，但对亲密的人不该保守，是什么就说什么，别把隐患留在未来。
en: With ordinary acquaintances, not going deep is right — read the context — but with those close to you one shouldn't be reserved; say it as it is, and don't leave hidden dangers for the future.

text: 但是行动是不会骗人的，不去关注这一点，等到双方出现大问题，可能都不会知道男人的想法。
en: But actions don't lie; if you don't pay attention to this, when big problems arise between the two of you, you may never know what the man is thinking.

text: 因为女人不喜欢的事情，大部分男人是不会强迫对方的，只会改变自己，或者自己去解决这个问题。
en: Because for the things women dislike, most men won't force the other party; they'll only change themselves, or solve the problem on their own.

text: 自己解决。
en: On their own.

text: 你以为他会只去看个电影么，多想想，没坏处
en: Do you think he would only go to watch a film? Think about it more — it does no harm
